slides.title: Bolt needs to remember
slides.text: Some doors open only when Bolt has picked up every gem on the way. How does a program remember how many it has? It uses a variable.
slides.alt: Bolt's row holds three gems, then a door, then the flag; the door's counter reads count = 3 and the starter program counts.

focus.cue: The door's counter: count = 3. Three gems open it.
Three gems, then the door, then the flag.
The door stays shut until count reaches 3.

slides.title: A box with a name
slides.text: A variable is a box with a name on it, like count. The program can look inside and change it while it runs. The number inside is its value.
slides.alt: The program names its box: set count to 0, then repeat 5 times move, pick up, and change count by 1, beside the gem column.

focus.cue: The box is named count. It starts at 0.
Move, pick up, change count by 1, five times: count climbs 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

slides.title: Set or change?
slides.text: Set puts a new number in the box: set steps to 4. Change by adds to what is already there, and a minus takes away: change steps by -1 makes 4 into 3.
slides.alt: Bolt stands by the door with the counter strip reading steps = 2: set steps to 4 started it, and change steps by -1 ticks it down.

focus.cue: Set puts a brand-new number in: steps = 4.
The change block adds its number. Here it is -1, so it takes one away.
Four times round, steps goes 4, 3, 2, 1, 0: the door opens at 0.

slides.title: Counting gems
slides.text: Every time Bolt picks up a gem, count goes up by one. Watch the count under the board: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5!
slides.alt: Halfway up the gem column, Bolt's counter pill reads count = 2: two gems picked up, two counted, and the change block is lit.

focus.cue: Under the board: count = 2. Two gems counted.
Two gems picked up so far, on the squares Bolt has climbed.
Bolt keeps climbing: 3, 4, 5 still to count.

words.means: a box with a name that a program can look in and change
what is inside the box right now
put a new value in the box
add to the value that is already there

slides.title: Your mission
slides.text: Open Robo Route at Variables and finish all 6 levels. Press Step and read the count under the board after each block: what is in the box now?
slides.alt: Bolt's row holds three gems, then a door, then the flag; the door's counter reads count = 3 and the starter program counts.

focus.cue: Your turn: press Step and read the counter each time.
